using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Moq;
using Moq.Protected;
using OpenRA.Graphics;
using OpenRA.Network;
using OpenRA.Primitives;
using OpenRA.Widgets;
using Xunit;

namespace OpenRA.Mods.Common.Widgets.Logic.Tests
{
	public class RegisteredProfileTooltipLogicTests
	{
		[Fact]
		public async Task ConstructorStartsProfileLoadingTask()
		{
			var widget = new Mock<Widget>();
			widget.Setup(w => w.Get(It.IsAny<string>())).Returns(new Mock<Widget>().Object);
			widget.Setup(w => w.Get<LabelWidget>(It.IsAny<string>())).Returns(new Mock<LabelWidget>().Object);
			widget.SetupAllProperties();

			var worldRenderer = new Mock<WorldRenderer>(Mock.Of<World>(), Mock.Of<ModData>(), null);
			var modData = new Mock<ModData>();
			var playerDatabase = new Mock<PlayerDatabase>();
			playerDatabase.Setup(p => p.Profile).Returns("https://example.com/profile/");
			modData.Setup(m => m.GetOrCreate<PlayerDatabase>()).Returns(playerDatabase.Object);

			var client = new Session.Client { Fingerprint = "test123" };

			var logic = new RegisteredProfileTooltipLogic(widget.Object, worldRenderer.Object, modData.Object, client);

			// Give the task some time to start
			await Task.Delay(100);

			// Verify that the async task was initiated (indirectly verified by widget setup calls)
			widget.Verify(w => w.Get("HEADER"), Times.Once());
		}

		[Fact]
		public async Task SuccessfullyLoadedProfileSetsProfileLoadedAndUpdatesUI()
		{
			var widget = CreateMockWidgetHierarchy();
			var worldRenderer = new Mock<WorldRenderer>(Mock.Of<World>(), Mock.Of<ModData>(), null);
			var modData = CreateMockModData("https://example.com/profile/");
			var client = new Session.Client { Fingerprint = "test123" };

			var httpClient = CreateMockHttpClientWithValidResponse();

			// Replace HttpClientFactory.Create to return our mock
			var originalCreate = HttpClientFactory.Create;
			HttpClientFactory.Create = () => httpClient;

			try
			{
				var logic = new RegisteredProfileTooltipLogic(widget.Object, worldRenderer.Object, modData.Object, client);

				// Wait for the async operation to complete
				await Task.Delay(2000);

				// Verify profile was loaded and UI updated
				Assert.True(((bool?)widget.Object.Get("HEADER").Get("PROFILE_HEADER").IsVisible()) ?? false);
			}
			finally
			{
				HttpClientFactory.Create = originalCreate;
			}
		}

		[Fact]
		public async Task FailedHttpRequestShowsErrorMessage()
		{
			var widget = CreateMockWidgetHierarchy();
			var worldRenderer = new Mock<WorldRenderer>(Mock.Of<World>(), Mock.Of<ModData>(), null);
			var modData = CreateMockModData("https://example.com/profile/");
			var client = new Session.Client { Fingerprint = "test123" };

			var httpClient = new Mock<HttpClient>();
			httpClient.Protected()
				.Setup<Task<HttpResponseMessage>>("SendAsync", ItExpr.IsAny<HttpRequestMessage>(), ItExpr.IsAny<CancellationToken>())
				.ThrowsAsync(new HttpRequestException("Network error"));

			var originalCreate = HttpClientFactory.Create;
			HttpClientFactory.Create = () => httpClient.Object;

			try
			{
				var logic = new RegisteredProfileTooltipLogic(widget.Object, worldRenderer.Object, modData.Object, client);
				await Task.Delay(1000);

				// Should still show message header (profile not loaded)
				Assert.False(((bool?)widget.Object.Get("HEADER").Get("PROFILE_HEADER").IsVisible()) ?? true);
			}
			finally
			{
				HttpClientFactory.Create = originalCreate;
			}
		}

		private static Widget CreateMockWidgetHierarchy()
		{
			var widget = new Mock<Widget>();
			widget.SetupAllProperties();

			var header = new Mock<Widget>();
			header.SetupAllProperties();
			widget.Setup(w => w.Get("HEADER")).Returns(header.Object);

			var profileHeader = new Mock<Widget>();
			profileHeader.SetupAllProperties();
			profileHeader.SetupGet(p => p.IsVisible).Returns(() => false);
			header.Setup(h => h.Get("PROFILE_HEADER")).Returns(profileHeader.Object);

			var messageHeader = new Mock<Widget>();
			messageHeader.SetupAllProperties();
			header.Setup(h => h.Get("MESSAGE_HEADER")).Returns(messageHeader.Object);

			var message = new Mock<LabelWidget>();
			message.SetupAllProperties();
			message.Setup(m => m.GetText()).Returns(() => "default");
			messageHeader.Setup(m => m.Get<LabelWidget>("MESSAGE")).Returns(message.Object);

			var badgeContainer = new Mock<Widget>();
			badgeContainer.SetupAllProperties();
			widget.Setup(w => w.Get("BADGES_CONTAINER")).Returns(badgeContainer.Object);

			return widget.Object;
		}

		private static Mock<ModData> CreateMockModData(string profileUrl)
		{
			var modData = new Mock<ModData>();
			var playerDatabase = new Mock<PlayerDatabase>();
			playerDatabase.Setup(p => p.Profile).Returns(profileUrl);
			modData.Setup(m => m.GetOrCreate<PlayerDatabase>()).Returns(playerDatabase.Object);
			return modData;
		}

		private static HttpClient CreateMockHttpClientWithValidResponse()
		{
			var handler = new Mock<HttpMessageHandler>();
			handler.Protected()
				.Setup<Task<HttpResponseMessage>>("SendAsync", ItExpr.IsAny<HttpRequestMessage>(), ItExpr.IsAny<CancellationToken>())
				.ReturnsAsync(new HttpResponseMessage(HttpStatusCode.OK)
				{
					Content = new StreamContent(new MemoryStream(System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(
						@"Player: { ProfileName: TestPlayer, ProfileRank: 100, Badges: [] }")))
				});

			return new HttpClient(handler.Object);
		}
	}
}
